task.instruction: Compare the prices and chips for the iPhone 14 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro models directly from Apple's website.

final_answer:
Apple's compare page shows no price for either phone. Both the iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 14 Pro read "Not available" for price and for every storage option. That means Apple isn't selling them directly on this page. The chips are listed and they differ.

| | iPhone 15 Pro | iPhone 14 Pro |
|---|---|---|
| Price on Apple's site | Not available | Not available |
| Chip | A17 Pro | A16 Bionic |
| CPU | 6-core (2 performance, 4 efficiency) | 6-core (2 performance, 4 efficiency) |
| GPU | 6-core | 5-core |
| Neural Engine | 16-core | 16-core |
| Hardware-accelerated ray tracing | Yes | Not available |

The page also shows these differences:
- **Connector:** The 15 Pro has USB-C with USB 3. The 14 Pro has Lightning with USB 2.
- **Frame and buttons:** The 15 Pro has a titanium frame and an Action button. The 14 Pro has a stainless steel frame and a Ring/Silent switch.
- **Wi-Fi:** The 15 Pro has Wi-Fi 6E. The 14 Pro has Wi-Fi 6.

The page also shows a third column, iPhone Duo, which I left out. It is the only one of the three with a price on that page (From $1999).

judge.rationale: The answer states no Apple prices are listed and gives the chips A17 Pro and A16 Bionic, supported by the page excerpt showing those chips and reseller availability.

final_page.title: iPhone 15 Pro vs iPhone 14 Pro - Apple
